items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: And I performed in his ensemble and rehearsed with him for the whole year

ctx.x: Okay. You can have two or three.

The year that I left college, in 1957, Harry Partch came to the college and did a residency. And I performed in his ensemble and rehearsed with him for the whole year, and then when that event was finished we put all his stuff in a truck and I drove his truck back up to Ohio, in Yellow Springs or someplace, Ohio, and then brought the memories and the truck back with me. That was probably the first really outstanding experience.
What was your role in that?
